text.en: Shoppers appreciate this independent boutique on Bloor Street West for its distinctive selection of vegan dog treats, compostable bags, and natural flea remedies. Clients note that the boutique stocks items rarely found in large chain stores. One reviewer raised concerns regarding shop cleanliness, but overall impressions remain very favorable.

Visitors consistently highlight owner Charles for his warm hospitality, in-depth product knowledge, and thoughtful recommendations. Pet parents value receiving tailored advice for pets with severe allergies and dietary sensitivities. One customer reported an unwelcoming interaction, though the vast majority praise the personal service.

Pet owners report finding specialized foods that suit even very finicky cats and severely allergic dogs. Visitors also enjoy meeting Otis, the friendly resident pet who greets customers at the door. Several reviewers mention that the shop's natural and allergy-safe supplies have significantly improved their animals' everyday wellbeing.

q.en: Does Bark & Meow carry vegan and hypoallergenic dog supplies?

a.en: Yes, reviewers specifically note the shop's excellent range of vegan dog treats and hypoallergenic options for sensitive pets.

q.en: What types of natural products are sold in store?

a.en: The boutique stocks compostable waste bags, herbal wellness supplements, natural flea preventatives, and non-toxic toys.

q.en: Is the store open on holidays?

a.en: Yes, visitors mention the shop being conveniently open on statutory holidays like Thanksgiving.

q.en: Does the boutique carry specialized cat supplies?

a.en: Yes, the shop features specialized cat foods for fussy felines along with flat feeding bowls and engaging toys.
